text: The initiality conjecture for HoTT (Brunerie et al.) states that the initial model of HoTT is:
choices: the type theory itself (the syntactic model is initial among all models)
explanation: The initiality conjecture: the syntactic category of HoTT is the initial ∞-topos with the appropriate structure. A proof by Brunerie-Lumsdaine-others is ongoing work.
